column1: Debit cards show absolute contraction: their 12-month average volume is 75% below its peak (12 months to Feb 2020). IMPS is the boundary case at absolute contraction (-19.8% from its peak, 12 months to Jul 2024). Credit cards kept growing but lost share to UPI P2M (-7.3 pp).
